entities.name: Pip
entities.description: The orange-furred house cat of the wizard Relno on Shandalar, enlarged to the size of a small whale to scare merfolk.

entities.name: Relno
entities.description: A wizard whose tower was raided by merfolk.

entities.name: Zurbit
entities.description: Relno's homunculus assistant who devised the plan to recover the stolen items.

events.summary: Merfolk raid Relno's tower and take his valuable possessions.
events.quote: Pip was present when the wizard's valuable possessions were taken

events.summary: Zurbit takes Pip and a vial of green liquid by rowboat to the reef.
events.quote: Zurbit and Pip ventured onto the water

events.summary: Zurbit sends a demanding message in a flask; a merfolk scorns it.
events.quote: A nearby merfolk surfaced, shot Zurbit a cold, contemptuous glare

events.summary: Zurbit feeds Pip the green liquid and Pip grows to the size of a small whale, looming over the merfolk.
events.quote: eventually reaching that of a small whale

events.summary: The stolen books and scrolls are recovered and Relno returns to find Pip grooming.
events.quote: all the stolen books and scrolls had been recovered from the depths

relations.quote: the orange-furred house cat of the wizard Relno
